blocks.text: Cast members of the 1990s Philippine sitcom “Ober da Bakod” reunited for an intimate dinner, more than two decades after the show ended. Angelu de Leon and Leo Martinez gave fans a glimpse of the reunion through their respective social media pages on Saturday, Oct. 3, sharing photos of the cast members posing together during the gathering. “Mga batang 90s, pakihulaan nga po kung anong show kami magkakasama. Sino kaya ang nakakaalala? Nostalgia overload!” de Leon wrote in her caption. “Mga Batang 90s, naaalala niyo pa ba kami?” Martinez wrote in his own post.
